title: Kodak 1888 — The Camera You Mailed Back

scenes.title: The camera you mailed back
scenes.narration: In 1888, Kodak sold a camera you could actually mail back when you finished shooting.
scenes.credit: EAS original AI editorial illustration, temporary crop for engineering QA

scenes.title: One hundred exposures
scenes.narration: For twenty five dollars, it came preloaded with enough film for one hundred pictures.
scenes.credit: EAS original AI editorial illustration, temporary crop for engineering QA

scenes.title: Send the whole camera
scenes.narration: When the roll was finished, customers sent the entire camera to the factory.
scenes.credit: EAS original AI editorial illustration, temporary crop for engineering QA

scenes.title: Kodak did the rest
scenes.narration: Kodak developed the photographs, reloaded the camera, and mailed it back. Would you do that today?
scenes.credit: EAS original AI editorial illustration, temporary crop for engineering QA
